<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
There's nothing on the screen.
<CLT=cltMIND>But just seeing it makes me feel sick...

<CLT=cltMIND>There's a large wooden dog statue on the
pedestal. It looks pretty old.

<CLT=cltMIND>Apparently, it's used in <CLT=cltSTRONG>The Caged Child<CLT=cltMIND>
seance...
Window
Cloth
Cage

<CLT=cltMIND>There are many items on display in the
glass case. I can't identify many of them, though.
<CLT=cltMIND>What a beautiful katana...

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks about a yard long,
and there's gold leaf on the handle.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's probably valuable...
I shouldn't touch it.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's packed with books and scrolls...
They're all weathered and old.

<CLT=cltMIND>I don't think I could read all of these
if I had a million years...
<CLT=cltMIND>There's a book in the display case.

<CLT=cltMIND>The bookcases were full of books,
but I imagine this one is special.
<CLT=cltMIND>Kiyo was particularly interested in this one...

<CLT=cltMIND>A handwritten book, the only copy
in the whole world...

<CLT=cltMIND>A history of the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Caged Dog Village<CLT=cltMIND>,
which fell 200 years ago.

<CLT=cltMIND>I don't want to get too close...
I can feel the <CLT=cltSTRONG>dark aura<CLT=cltMIND> around it from here.
